mapping.summary: Owner-side earned value management and cost forecasting for capital projects on BC Projects.
claims: Hierarchical work breakdown structure with control accounts and work packages
Each purchase order line is tagged to a WBS node, traced through receipt, invoice and G/L
Time-phased budgets with versions and lockable baselines
AFE spending gates block purchase orders over the approved authority
AFE supplements for extra funding approval
Pay items linked to purchase orders with unit price, lump sum and milestone types
Progress measured with weighted rules of credit and approval before earned value counts
Calculates BAC, committed, accrued (GRNI), actual cost, earned value, CPI, EAC and VAC
Four EAC methods including BAC/CPI, ETC+AC, management estimate and composite
WBS codes flow to G/L entries
Optional offline-capable field app for labour, equipment, materials and subcontractor receiving
Field receipts feed purchase orders for three-way match
Forecast snapshots built by Job Queue without affecting posting
Excel import and export for budgets and progress
Ten feature toggles, down to simple percent-complete tracking
Priced per user per month in CAD with all features
